title: VeloraOS 1.10.46 - Automatic Image & Vision Routing
releaseNotes: Detects images on the current user turn before Chat model routing.
Automatically routes image messages to an installed local vision model instead of Qwen2.5.
Prefers LLaVA 7B, falls back to Moondream, and supports other Ollama models that declare vision capability.
Vision routing is per-message, so later text-only turns return to the normal VeloraOS Main model.
Provides a clear install-vision-model message when no vision-capable local model is available.
Improves screenshot error analysis with dedicated instructions to read visible error text and avoid inventing unreadable details.
